'''Shieldship Nine''' was a [[shieldship]] owned by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a [[Unidentified shieldship pilot|pilot]].<ref name="Heir" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shieldship Nine first appeared in ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the first volume in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Heir" />
